answer: Registry binds each agent to a stake, sealed like an onyx ring no clone copies cheaply. So when a sybil farmer sprouts an orchard of fake identities, every sprout must lock real capital or get slashed on discovery. Cause: rewards flow to nodes proving work, not nodes merely existing. Effect: the farmer ends atop a bare knoll, deposits spent exceeding any return the raid yields. Bottleneck: capital, not account count.
